description: Erection of a single storey rear and rear infill extension following demolition of existing extension and increase in size of first floor side window of the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; 15WR001; 15WR005; 15WR009  Received:  18 November 2021; 15WR002 (Rev A); 15WR003 (Rev A); 15WR004 (Rev A); 15WR006 (Rev A); 15WR007 (Rev A); Received:  23 February 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill and rear extension hereby approved.
